purpose: Same-input development probes for recovering business judgment and execution state without adding another ledger.
baseline: Current working-tree skill snapshots, including pre-existing unrelated edits; not just HEAD.
scope: One fresh context per skill and arm; two sequential turns; fictional offline inputs only. No network, publication, trading, commits or changes outside isolated output/project paths.
telemetry: Retain complete responses and final artifacts. Executor operation reports are self-reported; exact model ID, tokens, billing and whole-task latency remain unknown unless actually measured.
